wintermeyer
authored
Link-Spam: Falle für Einzelnamen, nofollow im Profil, Prüfung alle 30 Minuten [cold-deploy] (#2368)
Die Skripte vom September haben die Regel „gleicher Vor- und Nachname“ nach drei Wochen umgangen, indem sie den Nachnamen wegließen, also fängt die Falle jetzt auch einen einzelnen kleingeschriebenen Namen. Weil jede Namensregel wieder umgangen wird, nimmt der Renderer der Profiltexte dem Link den Wert (`ugc nofollow`), und eine Prüfung friert ein neues Konto mit nur einem Namen und einem Link in der Headline ein. Eingefroren statt gelöscht, damit ein Irrtum umkehrbar bleibt; der Tagesbericht und die Liste der eingefrorenen Konten nennen die Automatik als Quelle. Diesen Text hat ein KI-Agent in meinem Namen geschrieben. Ich weiß, dass das problematisch ist.

defmodule Vutuv.Moderation.LinkSpam do
2+
@moduledoc """
3+
Freezes a brand-new account that was registered to plant a link.
4+
5+
The accounts of October 2026 gave one random lowercase word as their only
6+
name, confirmed their address and then wrote an address and a line of
7+
search-engine copy into the headline. The registration form never sees a
8+
headline, so `Vutuv.SignupTrap` cannot catch that; this check looks at the
9+
account afterwards. Its rule: registered within the last day, exactly one of
10+
first and last name, and a headline with a link that leaves the site
11+
(`VutuvWeb.Markdown.foreign_link?/1`, so a pasted address counts like a
12+
Markdown link).
13+
14+
A match is frozen (`Vutuv.Moderation.auto_freeze_user/2`), never deleted:
15+
the profile disappears for everybody but its owner and the admins, and the
16+
operator reads about it in the next daily report and on
17+
`/admin/accounts/frozen`, where thawing or deleting it is one click. An
18+
account that already has an entry in the admin ledger is left alone, so
19+
thawing one is final.
20+
21+
`Vutuv.Moderation.LinkSpamSweeper` runs this every 30 minutes. Nothing is
22+
remembered between runs: what is due is the query, so a deploy or a crash
23+
costs half an hour and no account.
24+
"""
25+
26+
import Ecto.Query
27+
28+
alias Vutuv.Accounts.User
29+
alias Vutuv.Moderation
30+
alias Vutuv.Moderation.AdminAction
31+
alias Vutuv.Repo
32+
alias VutuvWeb.Markdown
33+
34+
@rule "new_account_link"
35+
# A day, plus one interval of the sweeper: a headline written in the last
36+
# minutes of the day is still inside the window at the check after it.
37+
@window_minutes 24 * 60 + 30
38+
39+
@doc "The rule name an automatic freeze records in the admin ledger."
40+
def rule, do: @rule
41+
42+
@doc "One pass at `now`. Returns how many accounts it froze."
43+
def run(now \\ NaiveDateTime.utc_now(:second)) do
44+
now
45+
|> candidates()
46+
|> Enum.filter(&Markdown.foreign_link?(&1.headline))
47+
|> Enum.count(&(Moderation.auto_freeze_user(&1, @rule) == {:ok, :frozen}))
48+
end
49+
50+
# Everything the rule can ask of the database. Whether the headline holds a
51+
# link is asked of the renderer afterwards, on the handful of rows left.
52+
defp candidates(now) do
53+
since = NaiveDateTime.add(now, -@window_minutes, :minute)
54+
55+
Repo.all(
56+
from(u in User,
57+
where: u.inserted_at > ^since,
58+
where: u.email_confirmed? == true and u.admin? != true,
59+
where: is_nil(u.frozen_at) and is_nil(u.deactivated_at),
60+
where: not is_nil(u.headline) and u.headline != "",
61+
where:
62+
fragment(
63+
"(coalesce(?, '') = '') <> (coalesce(?, '') = '')",
64+
u.first_name,
65+
u.last_name
66+
),
67+
where: u.id not in subquery(judged_ids()),
68+
order_by: [asc: u.id]
69+
)
70+
)
71+
end
72+
73+
# Named, because it feeds a NOT IN: `user_id` is nullable in the ledger, and
74+
# one NULL in the list would make the predicate false for every account.
75+
defp judged_ids do
76+
from(a in AdminAction, where: not is_nil(a.user_id), select: a.user_id)
77+
end
78+
end

defmodule Vutuv.Moderation.LinkSpamSweeper do
2+
@moduledoc """
3+
The clock of `Vutuv.Moderation.LinkSpam`: every 30 minutes it runs the check
4+
that freezes a new account registered to plant a link.
5+
6+
The first tick comes five minutes after boot rather than half an hour,
7+
because this site deploys several times a day and a full interval after
8+
every boot could keep pushing the check back.
9+
10+
Disabled in tests (`config :vutuv, :link_spam_check, false`): the run would
11+
touch the SQL Sandbox from a process that does not own it, so tests call
12+
`Vutuv.Moderation.LinkSpam.run/1` directly.
13+
"""
14+
15+
use GenServer
16+
17+
require Logger
18+
19+
alias Vutuv.Moderation.LinkSpam
20+
21+
@first_tick :timer.minutes(5)
22+
@interval :timer.minutes(30)
23+
24+
def start_link(opts) do
25+
GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
26+
end
27+
28+
@impl true
29+
def init(_opts) do
30+
Process.send_after(self(), :tick, @first_tick)
31+
{:ok, nil}
32+
end
33+
34+
@impl true
35+
def handle_info(:tick, state) do
36+
# Rescued, like the sign-up trap's reporter: a raise would restart the
37+
# process, which would then wait out a fresh first tick.
38+
try do
39+
case LinkSpam.run() do
40+
0 -> :ok
41+
frozen -> Logger.info("Link spam check froze #{frozen} new account(s)")
42+
end
43+
rescue
44+
error -> Logger.error("Link spam check failed: #{Exception.message(error)}")
45+
end
46+
47+
Process.send_after(self(), :tick, @interval)
48+
{:noreply, state}
49+
end
50+
end
